prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity 1536x1024 landscape desktop website homepage screenshot, edge-to-edge UI with no browser frame, for the real Jonathan Graydon personal portfolio. Direction: Optical studio.
Structure in reading order: a restrained header at 60px side margins, small Jonathan Graydon wordmark at left and slim translucent smoked-glass capsule navigation at top right with Home, Projects, Music, Resume. A very fine horizontal rule and delicate small index line introduce the huge main hero. The hero is a dramatic asymmetric typographic composition: extremely large, tightly tracked, immaculate contemporary sans-serif name stacked as Jonathan then Graydon on the left, approximately 120px type, extending through the main visual field. On the right an exceptional mathematically precise optical glass torus made of nested refractive transparent rings floats at an oblique angle, carefully modeled sculptural 3D glass with silver highlights, subtle periwinkle refraction, dark transparent interior, precise optical caustics. It is intended to be a real interactive WebGL object, and should look technically exquisite. It occupies roughly the right 45% of the hero, without obscuring readable typography. Generous dark negative space and a deliberate, bold art-directed balance.
Under the stacked name put the real title in restrained medium text: "Computer Science Student at McMaster University | Software Engineer". Below that put exactly: "Computer Science student, software engineer, robotics programmer, and trumpet performer building polished digital and technical projects." Use a comfortable short multi-line measure. Two refined usable buttons beneath, solid offwhite "View Projects" with arrow and outlined "View Resume". The lower viewport transitions across a thin horizontal divider to actual portfolio content: small software, robotics, music discipline links, then the beginning of Selected projects with two beautifully typeset horizontal project previews titled "RouteLab" and "Personal Portfolio Website", with understated navigation arrows. This is the first viewport of a complete scrolling website retaining all portfolio content in the eventual build.
Palette: graphite #101113 background, offwhite #ededeb type, silver secondary text, restrained periwinkle #779cff accents, translucent glass. No colored gradients filling the page. Sophisticated custom studio typography and precise spacing. A website UI, never a poster. No invented credentials, counters, availability claims, testimonials, awards, dates, pricing, or project descriptions. No template SaaS cards or generic dashboard styling. All copy crisp and exact. Full fidelity outstanding award-caliber portfolio web design.
